description: Flat metadata schema for one record describing a biosynthetic gene cluster from a soil-derived bacterial genome, including isolate provenance, genomic location, gene-level annotation, and linked antibiotic characterization.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for this metadata record (one record per biosynthetic gene cluster). Example: BGC_0001.

sample_id.descr: Identifier of the original soil sample from which the bacterial isolate was obtained.

sample_collection_date.descr: Date when the soil sample was collected. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

sampling_site_name.descr: Name or code for the soil sampling site.

sampling_location.descr: Geographic location of the soil sampling site, preferably as place name or coordinates in text form.

sampling_environment.descr: Description of the soil environment or habitat. Examples: agricultural soil, forest soil, rhizosphere soil.

isolate_id.descr: Unique identifier for the bacterial strain/isolate studied.

isolate_source_material.descr: Source material from which the isolate was obtained. Example: soil suspension, enrichment culture.

taxon_name.descr: Lowest assigned taxonomic name for the isolate. Example: Streptomyces sp., Bacillus subtilis.

taxonomic_rank_confidence.descr: Confidence level for the taxonomic assignment. Example values: high, medium, low.

genome_accession.descr: Genome assembly accession or internal genome identifier associated with this isolate.

genome_assembly_level.descr: Assembly level of the genome used for BGC analysis. Example values: complete genome, scaffold, contig, draft.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing platform used to generate the genome data. Example: Illumina, Oxford Nanopore, PacBio.

assembly_method.descr: Genome assembly method or pipeline used to produce the assembly.

annotation_pipeline.descr: Gene prediction and annotation pipeline used for the genome. Example: Prokka, Bakta, NCBI PGAP.

bgc_identifier.descr: Unique identifier for the biosynthetic gene cluster within the genome.

bgc_detection_tool.descr: Software used to identify the biosynthetic gene cluster. Example: antiSMASH, DeepBGC.

bgc_detection_version.descr: Version of the BGC detection software used.

bgc_class.descr: Predicted biosynthetic class of the cluster. Examples: NRPS, PKS, RiPP, terpenes, siderophore, hybrid.

bgc_subclass.descr: More specific BGC subclass if available. Example: type I PKS, lanthipeptide, siderophore.

bgc_start_position.descr: Start coordinate of the biosynthetic gene cluster on the genome assembly (1-based).

bgc_end_position.descr: End coordinate of the biosynthetic gene cluster on the genome assembly (1-based).

bgc_strand.descr: Genomic strand on which the cluster is encoded. Acceptable values: +, -, or unknown.

bgc_length_bp.descr: Length of the biosynthetic gene cluster in base pairs.

contig_id.descr: Contig or chromosome name on which the cluster is located.

cluster_completeness.descr: Assessment of whether the BGC is complete, partial, or fragmented.

predicted_product_name.descr: Predicted or known name of the natural product associated with the cluster, if available.

product_family.descr: Broader chemical family of the antibiotic product. Example: macrolide, lipopeptide, aminoglycoside.

novelty_status.descr: Novelty assessment of the cluster or product. Example values: known, putative novel, novel.

antibiotic_activity_assayed.descr: Whether antimicrobial activity was experimentally assayed for the product or producing strain.

antibiotic_activity_result.descr: Result of antimicrobial activity testing. Example values: positive, negative, inconclusive, not tested.

activity_target_organism.descr: Indicator organism used in antimicrobial testing, if applicable.

activity_measurement_type.descr: Type of activity measurement. Examples: inhibition zone, MIC, growth inhibition percentage.

activity_measurement_value.descr: Numeric value of the antimicrobial activity measurement.

activity_measurement_unit.descr: Unit for the antimicrobial activity measurement. Examples: mm, µg/mL, nM.

metabolite_detected.descr: Whether a corresponding metabolite was detected by chemical analysis.

metabolite_name.descr: Name or tentative annotation of the detected antibiotic compound.

chemical_formula.descr: Chemical formula of the characterized antibiotic compound, if known.

exact_mass.descr: Exact mass of the compound measured by mass spectrometry, typically in Daltons (Da).

retention_time_min.descr: Chromatographic retention time of the compound, in minutes.

spectroscopy_method.descr: Analytical method(s) used for chemical characterization. Examples: LC-MS, MS/MS, NMR, HPLC.

structure_confirmed.descr: Whether the chemical structure was experimentally confirmed rather than only predicted.

gene_count_in_cluster.descr: Total number of genes annotated within the biosynthetic gene cluster.

core_biosynthetic_gene_count.descr: Number of core biosynthetic genes in the cluster.

regulatory_gene_count.descr: Number of regulatory genes annotated in the cluster.

transport_gene_count.descr: Number of transport/resistance genes annotated in the cluster.

gene_ids.descr: Comma-separated list of gene identifiers within the cluster, in genomic order.

gene_functions.descr: Summary of gene-level functional annotations for genes in the cluster. Use standardized gene names or brief functional labels.

key_biosynthetic_enzymes.descr: Key enzymatic domains or enzyme types involved in biosynthesis. Example: adenylation domain, ketosynthase, methyltransferase.

predicted_precursor_substrates.descr: Predicted building blocks or precursor substrates used by the cluster. Example: amino acids, malonyl-CoA, isoprenoid precursors.

evidence_level.descr: Overall evidence level supporting the cluster-product assignment. Example values: predicted, putative, experimentally validated.

biosynthesis_notes.descr: Free-text notes on biosynthetic logic, unusual features, tailoring reactions, or curation comments.

genome_coverage_depth.descr: Average sequencing coverage depth for the genome assembly, in fold coverage (x).

gc_content_percent.descr: GC content of the cluster or surrounding genomic region, as a percentage.

analysis_date.descr: Date on which the genome/BGC analysis was performed. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

curator_name.descr: Name or identifier of the person who curated the metadata record.

data_accession_url.descr: URL or accession reference for accessing the genome, cluster, or associated raw data.
